schema.label: Instance URL
schema.description: Base URL of your OpenWebTrack instance, e.g. http://localhost:8424 or https://analytics.example.com (no trailing slash).

schema.label: MCP Key (owt_mcp_...)
schema.description: Account MCP key owt_mcp_... from /account/mcp — lists all websites and gives full analytics. Recommended; no Website ID needed.

schema.label: Websites (JSON) — fallback per-site
schema.description: Fallback when no MCP key: JSON array of {id, name, apiKey}. id is UUID, apiKey is owt_... per site.

schema.label: Selected website ID
schema.description: UUID of the currently selected website. Set via the panel dropdown; you can also preset it here.

schema.label: Default period
schema.description: Default date range for v1 stats. 24h = last 24 hours, 7d = last 7 days, etc. Overridable in the panel.

schema.label: Default granularity
schema.description: Bucket size for timeSeries. Must be provided to GET /api/v1/[websiteId]/stats?granularity=...

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Poll interval for the bar widget. Also used as the panel auto-refresh timer.
